content: German players celebrate after the World Cup final soccer match between Germany and Argentina at the Maracana Stadium in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, Sunday, July 13, 2014. # World Cup 2014 Winner, Golden Boot Stats and Awards Results. The most impressive team throughout the World Cup ended up raising the trophy as Germany were able to come away with the 2014 title. Meanwhile, Colombia's James Rodriguez can also celebrate after winning the Golden Boot, an award given to the top scorer in the tournament. **Germany Beats Argentina 1-0 to Win World Cup**. RIO DE JANEIRO, BRAZIL - JULY 13: Mats Hummels of Germany celebrates with the World Cup trophy after defeating Argentina 1-0 in extra time during the 2014 FIFA World Cup Brazil Final match between Germany and Argentina at Maracana on July 13, 2014 in Rio. It was a thrilling final to watch throughout, but Germany were able to edge Argentina with a 1-0 win in extra time.
